verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents deleting files and folders through its Files API. It also documents plan-tiered windows (30 days, 180 days, 1 year) for restoring deleted files, which gives a retention backstop. However, nothing shows user-configurable retention policies or controls over permanent deletion or data purges, so retention is fixed by plan rather than controlled by the user. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, permanent/immediate purge controls, account-level data deletion documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Take actions on files and folders—like creating, reading, editing, moving, and deleting—with the Dropbox Files API
